entities.name: Nieuwe Kerk, Katwijk aan Zee
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Nieuwe Kerk in Katwijk, the Netherlands, is the oldest and best known work of the architect H.J. Jesse (1860–1943). It was built to replace the nearby Andreaskerk, which had become too small.
